description: This file defines a report parser class for follow-up print reports in the Odoo (OpenERP) system, including methods for retrieving partner addresses, move lines, and follow-up texts.

classes.name: report_rappel
classes.description: A report parser class for generating follow-up print reports, extending report_sxw.rml_parse.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates the local context with helper methods and modules.

methods.name: _ids_to_objects
methods.description: Converts partner IDs to partner names using the account_followup.stat model.

methods.name: _adr_get
methods.description: Retrieves the address of a partner based on the specified type.

methods.name: _lines_get
methods.description: Fetches move lines related to a partner that are receivable, unreconciled, and not in draft.

methods.name: _get_text
methods.description: Generates follow-up text for a partner based on follow-up lines and move lines, including dynamic content formatting.
